violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Owner/operator is registered in an approved food safety management course. Once successfully completed owner/operator must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 12/05/2026

Working containers of dry ingredients/spices are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Establishment does not have employee(s) certified in food safety management onsite during all hours of operation. Employee(s) must register in, and successfully complete, an approved course in food safety management. Once completed, one employee must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. New Violation. Correct By: 11/06/2025

Spray bottle used to store chemicals observed not labeled with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottles with chemicals must always be labeled. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2025
